M_fixed: Let eps* be the sup of eps such that, for D<=N^eps, any prescribed N^2/sqrt(D) entries of XY (X in Z^{N x D}, Y in Z^{D x N}, poly-bounded entries) can be computed in N^2/D^{gamma} word-RAM operations for some gamma=gamma(eps)>0. Majdoddin shows eps*>=ln4/(5 ln5)~0.17227. (a) Prove eps*>0.17227 (e.g. a base identity such as the thin product <34,2,35>, left open by Majdoddin), or (b) prove that no scheme in a precisely defined class (exact/border partial-product identities with shared inner variable, recursed as in AVW/Majdoddin) exceeds 0.17227.
notes: Core question open and posed by Majdoddin arXiv:2610.17420 (<34,2,35> open; App. A already has partial barriers, so (b) is partly done). But the stated payoff is stale: 3SUM is already O(n^1.965) without matrix multiplication (Chan-Itakura-Ma-Yu, Nov 2026), and better exponents come from larger gamma, not larger eps. Narrow technical question, not A.

M_fixed: For the vdBNS19 v-hinted Mv and Mv-hinted Mv conjectures with hint dimension n^tau, give an algorithm with polynomial saving for some tau>=0.17227 (ideally tau~0.53, the range used for the dynamic matrix inverse lower bounds), or prove the conjecture at some tau is equivalent to plain OMv.
notes: As stated it is already solved for tau in [0.1204, 0.17227): Majdoddin arXiv:2610.17420 Cor. 10.1 refutes Conj. 5.2/5.7 for all tau<0.17227 and Prop. 10.3 the uMv case for tau1<0.17227. Once fixed, the low-tau part is the same frontier as AS0-02; only the tau~0.53 target is distinct, and that is close to OMv itself.

M_fixed: (Gap) For every eps>0 there is q=q(eps) (independent of n) and an n-variable Unique Games instance over alphabet [q] with optimum value <=eps on which the degree-d SoS relaxation has value >=1-eps, for some d=d(n)=omega(1). Or (algorithm) there exist eps,delta>0 such that for every q a degree-d(q) SoS relaxation (d independent of n) distinguishes UG instances of value >=1-eps from value <=delta; this refutes UGC unless P=NP.
notes: Posed by Barak (SoS open problems; Barak-Steurer survey arXiv:1404.5236). No superconstant-degree SoS gap for UG found in fresh searches through 2026; known gap instances fall to constant degree (BBHKSZ 2012, O-Donnell-Zhou arXiv:1211.1958). Original M fix: fixed alphabet q(eps), and an algorithm refutes UGC assuming P!=NP (not a quasi-poly 2-to-2 assumption).

M_fixed: Let f(k,3) be the least m such that every family of m distinct k-element sets contains a 3-petal sunflower. Known: f(k,3) <= (C log k)^k (ALWZ, Rao, Bell-Chueluecha-Warnke). Prove f(k,3) <= (eps(k) log k)^k for some eps(k)->0, e.g. f(k,3) <= (log k)^{(1-c)k} for a constant c>0.
notes: No 2025-26 general improvement found; Mishra arXiv:2606.02667 (v2, Jun 2026) claims only shifted families. The log k barrier for spread/robust methods is stated in Lovett PCMI notes (Ex. 2.2, (log k)^{(1-o(1))k}) and Rao survey (JLMS 2026). Category fit is weak: sunflower is a conjecture, not a widely used assumption, but the target is a real weakening, not a restatement.
refs: Rao, The story of sunflowers, JLMS 2026 / arXiv:2509.14790
Lovett, PCMI lecture notes: from sunflowers to thresholds
